description: List assignable group memberships in Zendesk. Use when you need to retrieve the group memberships that agents can be assigned to, typically for understanding agent-group assignments or building assignment interfaces. This action is read-only and idempotent. Returns a maximum of 100 group memberships per page.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing assignable group memberships with pagination.

page.description: Page number for offset pagination (starts at 1). Cannot be used with cursor pagination.
page.human_parameter_description: Page number for offset pagination. Use with per_page. Cannot be used with cursor pagination.
page.title: Page

page_after.description: Cursor for fetching next page in cursor pagination. Use with page_size. Cannot be used with offset pagination.
page_after.human_parameter_description: Cursor token for pagination. Use with page_size to get the next page of results.
page_after.title: Page After

page_size.description: Number of records per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use with page_after. Cannot be used with offset pagination.
page_size.human_parameter_description: Page size for cursor pagination. Use with page_after cursor. Cannot be used with offset pagination.
page_size.title: Page Size

per_page.description: Number of group memberships to return per page (max 100).
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many group membership records to show per page. You can choose up to 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

name: list_assignable_group_memberships
